description: Swedish (Sweden) terminology, language conventions, and audit allowlist for AlgaPSA software used by managed service providers.

domainTerms.notes: Neuter: ett konto, konton. User, MSP, or customer account; a customer organization is kund. Preserve Account only within an official product or provider name.
Common gender: en åtgärd, åtgärder. UI or automation action.
Plural of en åtgärd; table action menu or workflow actions.
Adjective: aktiv, aktivt, aktiva. Agree with the entity: aktiv kund, aktivt avtal.
Plural of en timme; actual recorded hours, not current hours or estimated hours.
Imperative for an add action; no gender or number inflection.
Imperative; en post, poster. Use Lägg till rad when explicitly adding a document line.
Imperative; en tjänst, tjänster. Catalog or contract service.
Imperative; en status. A selectable state in a ticket or project workflow.
Plural of en handläggare; people assisting on tickets or project tasks, not software agents.
Common gender: en adress, adresser. Postal or street address; specify e-postadress for email.
Common gender: en handläggare, handläggare; gender-neutral person handling support work. A software or AI agent is en agent, agenter; retain Agent within official provider names.
Plural determiner. Use allt for a neuter uncountable whole and all for a common-gender mass noun.
Plural of en kategori.
Plural of en kund; customer organizations.
Plural of en prioritet.
Plural of en status; countable configured status values.
Plural of en typ.
Plural of en användare; plural has the same form as singular.
Neuter: ett belopp, belopp. Monetary amount; quantity of items is antal.
Adverb; yearly recurrence, not a duration of one year.
Adjective: valfri, valfritt, valfria. For an unrestricted filter, Alla or Alla typer may be more natural; in questions use någon/något/några as required.
Imperative for settings, rules, and filters. Applying a credit to an invoice is använd or avräkna, according to the operation.
Imperative; plural of ett filter is filter.
Common gender: en bokning, bokningar. A scheduled service appointment; boka is the action, bokad tid can clarify the calendar slot.
Plural of en bokningsförfrågan; requests for service appointments.
Neuter: ett godkännande, godkännanden. Approval of requests, invoices, or timesheets; use consistently for the product approval entity.
Imperative for approval actions, including timesheets.
Participle: godkänd, godkänt, godkända. En godkänd tidrapport; ett godkänt ärende.
Imperative for the action; the noun archive is ett arkiv, arkiv.
Participle: arkiverad, arkiverat, arkiverade; agree with the archived entity.

Common gender: en tillgång, tillgångar. Managed IT asset, including devices and configuration assets; use IT-tillgång when clarification is needed. Preserve Asset only within official product/provider names.
Neuter: ett inventarienummer, inventarienummer. Asset inventory identifier; a physical adhesive tag is an inventarieetikett, not a metadata tagg.
Plural of en tillgång; managed IT assets.
Imperative for assigning tickets, tasks, people, or resources.
Neuter singular: ett team, team; hence tilldelat. The team assigned to the work.
Label; use Tilldelat till for ett ärende or ett projekt, Tilldelad till for en uppgift, and Tilldelade till for plurals.
Person label: en ansvarig, ansvariga. Assigned owner of a ticket or task, not a legal assignee.
Common gender: en tilldelning, tilldelningar. Assigning work to a user, team, or technician.
Plural of en bilaga; attached files.
Common gender: en automatisering, automatiseringar; the process is normally uncountable. Automated operational behavior and workflows.
Adjective: tillgänglig, tillgängligt, tillgängliga. Resource availability; stock availability may require i lager.
Neuter: ett betyg, betyg; survey rating average.
Invariable navigation label.
Participle: fakturerad, fakturerat, fakturerade. Already included in invoicing; distinct from paid (betald).
Common gender: en debitering, debiteringar. Billing area, charge calculation, and billing settings; invoice creation is fakturering and an invoice is faktura.
Neuter: ett debiteringsintervall, debiteringsintervall. Frequency of recurring charges.
Common gender: en debiteringsmetod, debiteringsmetoder. Calculation method, not payment method (betalningsmetod).
Common gender: en tavla, tavlor. Ticket, kanban, or workflow board; ärendetavla or kanbantavla if clarification is needed.
Plural of en tavla; support or kanban boards.

Common gender: en timpott, timpotter. Prepaid or retained service hours; use förbrukningspott for a non-hour allowance. Keep bucket only in technical object-storage identifiers or official provider terminology.
Common gender: en budget, budgetar. Financial or project spending limit; a sales quote is offert.
Common gender: en kalender, kalendrar. Translate the generic noun; preserve official provider names such as Google Calendar when used as integration names.
Imperative for dismissing a dialog or aborting an operation. Use Avboka for an appointment, Annullera for an order, and Säg upp for a contract when that is the actual operation.
Participle: avbruten, avbrutet, avbrutna. Same meaning as Cancelled; use avbokad for appointments and annullerad for orders.
Participle: avbruten, avbrutet, avbrutna. Same as Canceled; domain-specific alternatives avbokad/annullerad follow the cancelled entity.
Plural of en kategori.
Common gender: en kategori, kategorier.
Imperative for an action. A change as a noun is en ändring, ändringar.
Common gender: en checklista, checklistor. Use the Swedish compound and plural.
Common gender: en ort, orter. Postal locality field; includes towns and villages.
Imperative; ett filter, filter. Clear the selected filter values.
Imperative for clearing selected rows/items; does not delete them.

Common gender: en kund, kunder. Customer organization and customer-facing portal context. Use klient only for a software/protocol client; keep Client inside an official provider name or a quoted external field label.
Plural of ett kundavtal; same singular/plural form.
Plural of en kunduppgift; details about the customer organization.
Neuter: ett kund-ID, kund-ID:n. Customer record identifier; an OAuth application client ID is klient-ID, and an exact external console label may remain Client ID when explicitly quoted.
Neuter: ett kundnamn, kundnamn.
Common gender: en kundportal, kundportaler. The customer-facing AlgaPSA app; write as one compound.
Plural of en kund; organizations served by the MSP.
Imperative for a dialog or ticket; do not confuse with cancelling or deleting.
Participle: stängd, stängt, stängda; a ticket is ett stängt ärende.
Common gender: en kommentar, kommentarer. Ticket, task, project, or document comment; action kommentera.
Participle: slutförd, slutfört, slutförda. Ett slutfört projekt, en slutförd uppgift.
Imperative; confirmation is distinct from approval (godkänna).
Imperative for connecting accounts, services, or devices.
Participle: ansluten, anslutet, anslutna.
Common gender: en kontakt, kontakter. CRM contact record; use kontaktperson when the person must be explicit.
Namn is neuter: ett namn, namn. Name of the contact person.
Plural of en kontakt; CRM contact records.
Imperative for proceeding in a flow.
Imperative for staying in the editor with existing changes.
Neuter: ett avtal, avtal. Service contract and its templates; use serviceavtal when clarification is needed.
Common gender head noun: en årsdag, årsdagar. Annual recurrence of the contract start date; not necessarily its renewal date.
Common gender: en avtalsrad, avtalsrader. Billable service entity within a contract; distinguish from a fakturarad.
Plural of en avtalsrad.
Neuter: ett avtalsnamn, avtalsnamn.
Plural of ett avtal; same singular/plural form.
Neuter result label, as in Det är kopierat; inflect kopierad/kopierade when explicitly qualifying a noun.
Imperative; a copy as an entity is en kopia, kopior.
Neuter: ett land, länder.
Imperative for creating an entity.
Imperative; en mall, mallar.
Imperative; ett ärende, ärenden. Support work, not a travel ticket.
Participle: skapad, skapat, skapade. Use Skapad as a creation-date heading; agree with an explicitly named entity.

Common gender: en kreditering, krediteringar. Credit transaction applied to an invoice; available balance is ett tillgodohavande, tillgodohavanden, and a credit memo is en kreditfaktura, kreditfakturor. Not a loan (kredit).
Plural of en kreditering for credit records. Use Tillgodohavanden when the UI means available customer balances, Kreditfakturor for credit documents.
Adjective: kritisk, kritiskt, kritiska; priority agrees with en prioritet.
Common gender: en valuta, valutor. Preserve ISO currency codes and actual transaction currency.
Adjective: aktuell, aktuellt, aktuella. Use nuvarande for the currently selected or incumbent entity when clearer.
Adjective: anpassad, anpassat, anpassade. User-defined settings or values.
Common gender: en taxa, taxor. An overridden billing rate.
Common gender: en översiktspanel, översiktspaneler. Product dashboard; reserve översikt for overview. Preserve Dashboard only in official product names or verbatim external UI labels.
Neuter: ett datum, datum. Calendar date, not data or an appointment.
Neuter: ett datumintervall, datumintervall.
Common gender: en dag, dagar. Calendar day; use dygn only for an explicit 24-hour duration.
Plural of en dag; never retain English d as an unexplained translated abbreviation.
Participle: avböjd, avböjt, avböjda. A quote or invitation is avböjd; a payment rejection may be nekad.
Invariable UI label and compound prefix, as in standardinställning. As an adjective for a preselected value use förvald/förvalt/förvalda.
Common gender: en standardkontakt, standardkontakter.
Common gender: en standardtaxa, standardtaxor.
Imperative for deleting a record or file; remove/unlink is ta bort.
Imperative; en mall, mallar. Deletes the template.
Participle: levererad, levererat, levererade. Physical delivery; a quantity column can use Levererat antal.
Common gender: en beskrivning, beskrivningar.
Plural of en detalj. Use uppgifter for personal/customer data where more idiomatic.
Imperative for turning off a feature or account without deleting it.
Participle: inaktiverad, inaktiverat, inaktiverade.
Imperative for discarding unsaved edits or drafts; Kasta ändringar when the object is not clear.
Imperative; plural of en ändring. Discard unsaved changes.
Imperative for ending an integration or device connection.
Participle: frånkopplad, frånkopplat, frånkopplade.
Plural of en rabatt; billing discounts.
Common gender: en resursplanering; normally uncountable. Workspace for scheduling technicians and assigning service work; never shipping or mail dispatch.
Common gender: en visningsordning, visningsordningar. Display sequence, not a purchase or sales order.
Neuter: ett dokument, dokument. Uploaded or generated document entity; a folder is mapp.
Plural of ett dokument; same singular/plural form.
Imperative; downloading as a process is nedladdning. Use ner consistently in action labels.
Imperative; keep PDF uppercase as a file-format acronym.
Neuter: ett utkast, utkast. Unsaved or unpublished document stage; fakturautkast for an invoice draft.
Verb label for when payment is due. A task deadline can be Ska vara klar; do not imply the item is already overdue.
Neuter: ett förfallodatum, förfallodatum. Payment or work deadline; Sista datum can clarify a task deadline.
Common gender: en varaktighet, varaktigheter. Elapsed or scheduled length, not the start time.
Imperative for editing existing data.
Imperative; en tillgång, tillgångar.
Imperative; en plats, platser. Customer or service location.
Common gender mass noun: e-posten; individual message ett e-postmeddelande, e-postmeddelanden. Use the hyphen; preserve Email only in an official provider/product name or quoted external label.
Common gender: en e-postadress, e-postadresser. Preserve address values exactly.
Common gender: en e-posttyp, e-posttyper. Type picker on an address row, such as work/private; not the address itself.
Imperative for enabling a feature or account.
Participle: aktiverad, aktiverat, aktiverade.
Neuter: ett slut, slut. Range endpoint; for the action use Avsluta.
Neuter: ett slutdatum, slutdatum.
Common gender: en sluttid, sluttider.
Neuter: ett fel, fel. Error message or validation failure.
Plural of ett fel; same singular/plural form.
Plural of en timme; estimated effort, distinct from actual hours.
Common gender: en händelse, händelser. Automation/system event; kalenderhändelse for a calendar item.
Participle: utgången, utgånget, utgångna. Validity ended; a payment overdue is förfallen.
Imperative for exporting data; the process noun is en export, exporter.
Imperative; retain CSV uppercase.
Neuter: ett tillägg, tillägg. Installed platform extension; file extension is filändelse and phone extension anknytning. Preserve official extension names.
Information is a common-gender mass noun; tillägget is definite singular of ett tillägg, tillägg. Details of a platform extension.
Plural of en tilläggsinställning; settings of installed extensions.
Plural of ett tillägg; installed product extensions, whose official names remain unchanged.
Finite verb used as a result/status label. Before a noun use misslyckad/misslyckat/misslyckade.
Common gender: en fil, filer. Uploaded or generated file; not an archive (arkiv) or folder (mapp).
Neuter: ett filter, filter. UI noun; action filtrera.
Plural of ett filter; no English -s plural.
Neuter: ett förnamn, förnamn.
Adjective: fast, fast, fasta; fixed billing model. Use åtgärdad for a repaired issue, never for fixed-price billing.
Neuter: ett pris, priser; a flat price, not an hourly rate.
Preposition for a sender, origin, or range start.
Common gender: en avsändaradress, avsändaradresser. Email sender address.

Common gender: en orderhantering; normally uncountable. Sales-order fulfillment process; use Leveranssätt for the line column choosing stock versus drop-ship, and leverans when invoicing is triggered by shipment. Distinguish from delivered quantity (levererat antal).

Common gender mass noun: materialförbrukning. Closed hardware tickets with potentially consumed but unrecorded parts; candidates indicate suspected missing records, not confirmed theft or fictitious usage.
Imperative; hides content without deleting it.
Adjective: hög, högt, höga. Priority agrees with en prioritet.
Common gender: en timme, timmar; unit symbol h.
Invariable billing-model label. For recurrence use Varje timme; for hourly-priced services use timdebiterad/timdebiterat/timdebiterade.
Common gender: en timtaxa, timtaxor. Explicitly hourly billing rate.
Plural of en tjänst with plural adjective; services charged by recorded hours.
Plural of en timme; use h as the compact unit symbol.
Common gender: en identitet, identiteter. User/authentication identity; preserve provider names.
Imperative for importing data; the process noun is en import, importer.
Imperative with plural object; selected rows/items.
Finite verb status label, invariant across entity genders and numbers. Before a noun use pågående.
Adjective: inaktiv, inaktivt, inaktiva.
Common gender: en bransch, branscher. CRM business sector; industri is specifically manufacturing.
Plural of en interaktion; logged CRM interactions with a customer or contact.
Adjective: intern, internt, interna; internal visibility or work.
Plural of en anteckning; internal notes hidden from customers.
Neuter: ett lager, lager. Procurement and stock inventory area; use inventarier for managed equipment and inventering for stocktaking.
Common gender: en faktura, fakturor. Customer invoice entity; not a receipt (kvitto) or billing process.
Neuter: ett fakturanummer, fakturanummer. Preserve identifier values.
Neuter: ett faktureringsintervall, faktureringsintervall. Window grouping recurring charges for invoicing; distinct from the service coverage period (tjänsteperiod).
Plural of en faktura.
Common gender: en fakturering, faktureringar; normally a process noun. Creation and issuance of invoices; billing calculation is debitering.
Neuter: ett bakgrundsjobb, bakgrundsjobb. Scheduled/background job entity; a specific execution is en körning, körningar, and a project task is uppgift.
Invariable relative-time adverb.
Common gender: en kunskapsbas, kunskapsbaser. Articles, categories, and review flows.
Common gender: en inloggning, inloggningar. Most recent successful sign-in.
Neuter: ett efternamn, efternamn; family name.
Timestamp heading; uppdaterad/uppdaterat/uppdaterade agrees with an explicit entity. Senast is an adverb.
Imperative; definite singular of en sida, sidor.
Common gender: en licens, licenser. Software entitlement, activation, or licensed seat; preserve official license product names.
Plural of en rad. Invoice/quote/order lines; specify fakturarader, offertrader, or orderrader when needed.
Common gender: en lista, listor. List view; as an action use Visa lista or Lista according to context.
Imperative with countable plural items; Ladda mer only for uncountable content.
Common gender: en plats, platser. Customer/service/storage location; position for GPS coordinates, ort for postal locality.
Adjective: låg, lågt, låga; priority agrees with en prioritet.
Neuter mass noun: underhållet. IT equipment or system maintenance.
Imperative for managing records or settings.
Adjective: manuell, manuellt, manuella. Manual operation; a user manual is en handbok, handböcker.
Common gender: en förnyelse, förnyelser. Renewal requiring user action.
Participle: mappad, mappat, mappade. Explicit field or integration mapping; not a geographical map.
Common gender: en marginal, marginaler. Financial margin; preserve whether the source is a percentage or amount.
Invariable middle priority label; not a physical medium.
Common gender: en milstolpe, milstolpar. Project milestone, including milestone billing.
Plural of en minut; duration unit symbol min. Meeting minutes are protokoll.
Compact type label from en mobiltelefon, mobiltelefoner. Sweden uses mobil, not Finland-Swedish kännykkä.
Common gender: en månad, månader.
Adverb for monthly recurrence; every month, not a duration of one month.
Neuter: ett namn, namn. Translate the label; preserve real person, organization, and product names.
Verb phrase status label, invariant across gender and number.
Neuter: ett nätverk, nätverk. Computer network.
Invariable adverb for a missing event or disabled recurrence.
Neuter: ett lösenord, lösenord; adjective nytt.
Common gender: en offert, offerter; adjective ny.
Invariable navigation label; Fortsätt can be used when proceeding rather than selecting the next item.
Invariable negative answer, not an abbreviation for number.
Common gender singular: en beskrivning; hence ingen.
Inflect ingen/inget/inga to the missing entity. A generic empty option may use Ingen; no selection can be Inget valt.
Participle: inte tilldelad, inte tilldelat, inte tilldelade; agree with the entity.
Participle: inte konfigurerad, inte konfigurerat, inte konfigurerade.
Participle: inte ansluten, inte anslutet, inte anslutna.
Neuter default for an unspecified value; use inte angiven/inte angivna for common gender/plural.
Plural of en anteckning. Notes attached to business records; not notifications.
Common gender: en avisering, aviseringar. In-app or email notification; do not collapse into a comment or note.
Plural of en avisering.
Neuter: ett nummer, nummer. Record/document identifier; a numerical value is tal and an item count antal.

Common gender: en introduktion, introduktioner. Guided introduction of customers or users; use kom igång for a welcome action and inledande konfiguration for setup steps. Preserve Onboarding only within official product/provider names.

Common gender: en engångsdebitering, engångsdebiteringar. Standalone billing-model label; before a noun use a compound such as engångsavgift or engångstjänst. In nonbilling prose use vid ett tillfälle.
Invariable participial adjective for work still underway.
Imperative; en meny, menyer.
Plural of en affärsmöjlighet; CRM sales opportunities.
Common gender: en affärsmöjlighet, affärsmöjligheter. A sales opportunity; stage agreement vunnen/förlorad.
Adjective: valfri, valfritt, valfria. Ett valfritt fält; optional is not obligatory.
Common gender: en order, order. Commercial order; use ordning for sequence/sorting. Purchase order is inköpsorder, sales order försäljningsorder.
Neuter generic option; use annan for common gender, andra for plurals, or Övrigt for a miscellaneous category.
Participle: förfallen, förfallet, förfallna for unpaid amounts/invoices past due. Work past its deadline is försenad/försenat/försenade.
Common gender: en översikt, översikter. Summary tab or section; dashboard is översiktspanel.
Neuter: ett lösenord, lösenord. Never translate the password value.
Plural of ett lösenord; same singular/plural form.
Imperative; the noun is en paus, pauser.
Participle: pausad, pausat, pausade.
Common gender: en nyttolast, nyttolaster. Event/API data payload; preserve payload keys and sample JSON identifiers.
Common gender: en betalning, betalningar. Invoice or online payment; not billing or a credit.
Plural of ett betalningsvillkor; same singular/plural form.
Invariable participial adjective. Use Väntar på godkännande/betalning when the awaited event is specified.
Common gender: en period, perioder. Time interval in billing/reporting.
Common gender: en fas, faser. Project phase, distinct from a CRM stage.
Common gender: en telefon, telefoner. Contact field or device.
Neuter: ett telefonnummer, telefonnummer. Preserve supplied number values and country codes.
Common gender: en plocklista, plocklistor. Warehouse picking document; picked is plockad/plockat/plockade, not merely completed.
Common gender: en säljpipeline, säljpipeliner. CRM sales stages; not a physical pipeline. Technical CI/data pipelines may use pipeline; preserve official product names.
Neuter: ett inköpsordernummer, inköpsordernummer. Procurement PO identifier, distinct from sales order number.

Neuter singular head noun nummer. Customer-provided PO reference on invoices/quotes; do not replace with generic reference if that loses the PO meaning. Use Ert only when explicitly addressing the customer organization collectively.
Neuter: ett postnummer, postnummer. Swedish example 123 45; preserve actual international postal-code values.
Imperative for the action; noun en förhandsgranskning, förhandsgranskningar for a pane or mode.
Invariable navigation label; previous page/item.
Common gender: en e-postadress, e-postadresser; primär/primära. Main address on a customer/contact record, not an email message.
Imperative for document printing.
Plural of ett utskriftsalternativ; same singular/plural form.
Common gender: en skrivare, skrivare. IT device type.
Plural of en prioritet.
Common gender: en prioritet, prioriteter. Ticket/task priority; hög, medel, låg, kritisk as labels.
Common gender: en produkt, produkter. Catalog/stock product; preserve its official product name.
Plural of en produkt.
Common gender: en profil, profiler. User profile.
Neuter: ett förlopp, förlopp. Progress of an operation or project; use slutförandegrad when explicitly showing percentage complete.
Neuter: ett projekt, projekt. Project management entity with phases, tasks, and budgets.
Plural of en projektfas.
Common gender: en projektuppgift, projektuppgifter.
Plural of en projektuppgift.
Plural of ett projekt; same singular/plural form.
Common gender: en tjänsteleverantör, tjänsteleverantörer. Email, identity, integration, or managed-service provider; preserve provider names such as Microsoft, Google, Stripe, and NinjaOne exactly.
Imperative for making an article, template, or workflow version available.
Participle: publicerad, publicerat, publicerade.

Common gender: en inköpsorder, inköpsorder. Procurement order, including the customer's PO reference and orders to vendors; sales order is försäljningsorder. Preserve PO in literal external codes only.
Plural of en inköpsorder; same singular/plural form.
Neuter: ett antal. Compact quantity heading for item counts; no English abbreviation Qty.
Neuter: ett antal. Countable units; use mängd for continuous quantities such as weight or volume.
Adverb for recurrence every three months.
Common gender: en offert, offerter. Sales/service quote; never citat (quotation), kvot (quota), or budget (spending plan).
Plural of en offert; sales quotations.
Common gender: en taxa, taxor. Priced billing rate; timtaxa only when explicitly hourly. Keep distinct from unit price (enhetspris); percentage tax rate is skattesats.
Adjective: klar, klart, klara. Ready for the next operation; not necessarily completed.
Common gender: en orsak, orsaker. Cause/reason field; use motivering for a required explanatory justification.
Participle: mottagen, mottaget, mottagna. Received stock/message; quantity heading Mottaget antal.
Invariable adjective for recurring charges, services, and schedules.
Common gender: en referens, referenser. Reference field or identifier; preserve values.
Imperative for reloading displayed data; update/edit is uppdatera.
Invariable adjective for remaining time, quantity, or balance.
Imperative for removing a selection, association, or item; use radera for explicit deletion of a stored record.
Common gender: en rapport, rapporter. Analytics, operational, billing, or audit report; verb rapportera.
Plural of en rapport.
Common gender: en förfrågan, förfrågningar. Service or appointment request; begäran for a formal approval/access request and anrop for a technical HTTP request.
Imperative; plural of en ändring. Ask the submitter to revise the record.
Adjective: obligatorisk, obligatoriskt, obligatoriska. Mandatory field/step; use krävs in full validation sentences.
Imperative for resetting values or passwords; restarting a process is starta om.
Common gender: en svarsstatus, svarsstatusar. Survey response state.
Plural of ett svar; survey or request responses.
Imperative for retrying a failed operation; same wording as Try again.
Imperative for revoking permission, access, invitations, or tokens.
Common gender: en roll, roller. Authorization/user role.
Plural of en roll.
Plural of en försäljningsorder; customer sales orders, distinct from vendor inköpsorder.
Imperative for persisting edits or records.
Imperative; plural of en ändring.
Neuter: ett schema, scheman. Calendar/work schedule; verb schemalägg, process schemaläggning. Project schedule can be tidsplan.
Participle: schemalagd, schemalagt, schemalagda.
Common gender: en skärm, skärmar. Display/screen; use vy for a UI view and sida for a page when those are meant.
Imperative for a button or search placeholder; noun en sökning, sökningar.
Common gender mass noun: säkerheten. Account and information security.
Imperative for choosing an option; markera for checking/selecting rows.
Imperative with plural object; select all rows/items.
Imperative; en tavla, tavlor.
Imperative; en kund, kunder.
Imperative; en kontakt, kontakter.
Imperative; en valuta, valutor.
Imperative; ett datum, datum.
Imperative; en status, statusar.
Imperative; en användare, användare.
Adverb for every six months; not every two years.
Neuter: ett serienummer, serienummer. Compact inventory identifier label; adjective serial in protocols is seriell.
Neuter: ett serienummer, serienummer. Preserve literal serial-number values.
Common gender: en server, servrar. Established IT noun; Swedish plural, never servers.

Common gender: en tjänst, tjänster. Catalog item, managed service, or support service. Preserve official service names; service is appropriate only for maintenance/customer-service senses, not the catalog entity.
Common gender: en tjänstekatalog, tjänstekataloger. Billable service catalog; one compound.
Neuter: ett tjänstenamn, tjänstenamn. Translate the field label, preserve official named services.
Common gender: en tjänsteperiod, tjänsteperioder. Coverage period of a service; distinct from the invoice grouping window (faktureringsintervall).
Plural of en tjänsteförfrågan; service requests from clients.
Plural of en tjänst; catalog and contracted services.
Plural of en inställning; settings pages and controls.
Imperative for simulating an operation or workflow.
Common gender: en inloggning, inloggningar. SSO feature; use enkel inloggning (SSO) when clarification is useful. Preserve the acronym SSO and official provider feature names.
Imperative for omitting a step or record.
Participle: överhoppad, överhoppat, överhoppade.
Keep uppercase English acronym. Neuter by its expansion: ett servicenivåavtal, servicenivåavtal; write SLA-avtal or several SLA-avtal rather than inventing an English plural.
Common gender: en källa, källor. Data origin or incoming-channel source.
Common gender: en överenskommelse, överenskommelser. CRM stage indicating verbal commitment; not the bare adjective verbal.
Common-gender participles agreeing with en affärsmöjlighet; plural vunna/förlorade. Actions Markera som vunnen/förlorad; never finite verbs vann/förlorade as singular stage labels.
Common gender: en start, starter. Start point or heading; action button Starta.
Neuter: ett startdatum, startdatum.
Common gender: en starttid, starttider.
Participle: startad, startat, startade. Timestamp heading may use Startad; full sentences may use startade as the past-tense verb.
Neuter: ett tillstånd, tillstånd. Technical/process state; use status for workflow state labels and delstat/region only in postal addresses.
Common gender: en status, statusar for countable configured values; definite singular statusen. Do not use English statuses or German invariant plurals for selectable statuses.
Plural of en status for the product's configurable state values.
Neuter: ett lagerbestånd, lagerbestånd. Inventory on hand; use i lager for the availability state. Not shares (aktier).
Neuter: ett ämne, ämnen. Email/ticket subject line.
Imperative for submitting a timesheet, request, or form for processing/approval.
Participle: inskickad, inskickat, inskickade. Submitted for processing, not necessarily approved.
Common gender: en delsumma, delsummor. Amount before subsequent taxes/discounts according to the source calculation.
Verb result label; use åtgärden lyckades or a concrete completed action in notifications, not a literal noun framgång.
Participle: föreslagen, föreslaget, föreslagna.
Common gender: en enkät, enkäter. Satisfaction survey and its templates/responses.
Neuter: ett system, system. Application system or system-originated actor.
Common gender: en tagg, taggar. Metadata label; use Swedish double g and plural, not English tag/tags.
Plural of en tagg; metadata labels.
Common gender: en uppgift, uppgifter. Project/workflow/inbox task; background execution entity is bakgrundsjobb.
Common gender: en uppgiftstyp, uppgiftstyper.
Plural of en uppgift.
Common gender: en skatt, skatter. Generic tax on documents; use moms only when the source specifically means VAT. Locale does not determine tax jurisdiction.
Neuter: ett team, team; definite teamet/teamen. Preserve Teams only for the Microsoft product, not as the plural of team.
Common gender: en tekniker, tekniker. Gender-neutral service/field technician; plural definite teknikerna.
Common gender: en mall, mallar. Project, contract, document, or email template.
Neuter: ett mallnamn, mallnamn.
Plural of en mall.

Common gender: en klientorganisation, klientorganisationer. Isolated tenant, distinct from a customer (kund); also used by Microsoft in Swedish: https://learn.microsoft.com/sv-se/entra/fundamentals/create-new-tenant. Preserve tenant identifiers and official provider names; a verbatim English external field label may remain Tenant ID when explicitly quoted.
Common gender: en standardinställning, standardinställningar. Tenant-wide default, distinct from user/client overrides; plural when several settings are meant.
Participle: avslutad, avslutat, avslutade. Ended contract/process; use uppsagd for a contract explicitly terminated by notice.
Imperative; en anslutning, anslutningar.

Neuter: ett ärende, ärenden; definite ärendet/ärendena. MSP support ticket; supportärende when clarification is needed. Never biljett; preserve Ticket only within official product/provider names or literal identifiers.
Plural of en standardinställning and ett ärende; default settings for support tickets.
Common gender: en tid, tider. Time/duration; use klockslag when explicitly referring to the time of day.
Common gender: en tidpost, tidposter. One recorded block of work time, billable or nonbillable. Time tracking is tidregistrering; a submitted collection is a tidrapport.
Common gender: en tidslinje, tidslinjer. Chronological activity or project visualization.
Common gender: en tidrapport, tidrapporter. Grouped time entries submitted for approval; not an attendance clock or scheduling grid.
Common gender: en titel, titlar. Record/article title; rubrik for a section heading and befattning for a person's job title where appropriate.
Preposition for a recipient, destination, or range end; till och med where an inclusive end date must be explicit.
Invariable adverb/navigation label; use idag consistently.
Adverbial total label. Use totalsumma (en totalsumma, totalsummor) for an explicit monetary noun; adjective total/totalt/totala must agree.
Common gender: en utlösare, utlösare. Event/condition starting an automation; literal code identifiers remain unchanged.
Common gender: en utlösartyp, utlösartyper.
Imperative; same wording as Retry.
Common gender: en typ, typer. Type/category label; verb type text is skriv.
Participle: ej tilldelad, ej tilldelat, ej tilldelade. Compact status label; use inte tilldelad in prose.
Common gender: en enhet, enheter. Billing or measurement unit, not necessarily a device.
Common gender: en enhetskostnad, enhetskostnader. Internal cost per unit; distinct from the selling price.
Neuter: ett enhetspris, enhetspriser. Per-unit selling price; keep distinct from taxa and enhetskostnad when columns coexist.
Plural of en enhet.
Adjective: okänd, okänt, okända; agree with the unknown entity.
Common gender singular: en kund; hence okänd.
Neuter singular: ett fel; hence okänt.
Common gender singular: en tjänst; hence okänd.
Adjective: obegränsad, obegränsat, obegränsade.
Participle: inte mappad, inte mappat, inte mappade. Missing field/integration mapping; distinct from an unmatched record.
Invariable phrase for a record with no matching counterpart; not the same as an absent configured mapping.
Plural of en ändring with plural adjective; changes not yet persisted.
Invariable phrase; en titel, titlar.
Imperative for modifying/updating saved data; refreshing the current view is ladda om.
Participle: uppdaterad, uppdaterat, uppdaterade; agree with the entity.
Imperative; en fil, filer. Upload to the service, distinct from download.
Common gender: en förbrukning; normally uncountable. Metered billable consumption; use användning for general feature/software use.
Adjective: förbrukningsbaserad, förbrukningsbaserat, förbrukningsbaserade. Billing based on metered consumption.
Plural of en tjänst with plural adjective; metered services.
Common gender: en användare, användare; definite användaren/användarna. Gender-neutral application user, not the customer organization.
Neuter: ett användarnamn, användarnamn. Preserve actual login values.
Label; giltig/giltigt/giltiga agrees with the entity. Use Giltig till och med only when the end is explicitly inclusive.
Neuter: ett värde, värden. Field or monetary value; translate the label, not machine-readable values.
Common gender: en leverantör, leverantörer. Procurement supplier; use tjänsteleverantör for service providers. Preserve all vendor company and product names exactly.
Common gender: en version, versioner. Preserve version identifiers and semver syntax.
Imperative for displaying a record; a view as a noun is en vy, vyer.
Imperative for displaying all countable items; Visa allt for uncountable content.
Imperative; plural of en detalj.
Common gender: en varning, varningar. Warning, distinct from an error.

Established technical loanword; common gender: en webhook, webhookar, definite webhooken/webhookarna. Keep singular English spelling and official provider names; do not retain English webhooks as the Swedish plural.
Adverb for weekly recurrence; not a duration of one week.
Neuter noun used as a phone-type label: ett arbete, arbeten. For an explicit phone field use arbetstelefon; never the verb arbeta as the type label.

Neuter: ett arbetsflöde, arbetsflöden. Event-driven automation with triggers, actions, and runs, not merely ticket status transitions. Preserve Workflow only within official product/provider names or literal API identifiers.
Common gender: en arbetsstation, arbetsstationer. Managed computer asset, not a workplace/location.
Invariable affirmative answer.

forbiddenTerms.reason: A travel or admission ticket is the wrong sense for MSP support work.
Plural travel/admission sense; support records are ärenden.
Translate the generic support entity in Swedish; literal codes and official product names are separate contexts.
English plural is not the Swedish support entity label.

forbiddenTerms.enWhen: ^(?:client(?: name| details| contracts| portal)?|select client|unknown client|new client|edit client)$
forbiddenTerms.reason: These customer labels refer to the MSP's customer, not a software client. Klient remains valid for OAuth/software clients and in klientorganisation.
Customer organizations are kunder; software clients are a separate sense.
Citat is a textual quotation, not a commercial quotation. It remains valid in document-editor quotation features.
Kvot means quota or mathematical ratio, not a sales quote.
The sales quote is an offert; budget is reserved for a project/financial spending plan.
A receipt confirms payment; an invoice requests payment.
Receipts and invoices are different financial documents.
Generic invoice credit is a credit transaction or available balance, not borrowed money. Kredit remains valid for credit facilities and in compounds such as kreditfaktura.
Do not label invoice credits as loans.
Generic tax must not be narrowed to VAT; moms is correct only when VAT is explicitly meant.
Financial shares are the wrong sense for stock inventory.
Inventering means the act of stocktaking, not the stock-management product area.
A corporate board of directors is not a support or kanban board.
Plural wrong sense for support/kanban boards.
Literal physical bucket; a contracted pool of hours is a timpott. Object-storage terminology is separate.
Plural literal bucket is wrong for contracted hour pools.
Shipping/administrative dispatch is the wrong sense for technician scheduling.
Mail or shipment dispatch is not the technician planning workspace.
A physical gas conduit is not a CRM sales pipeline.
The generic CRM sector field covers all business sectors, not just manufacturing.
English actual means factual/real; Swedish aktuell means current. Inflect faktiska timmar, faktisk kostnad.
Plural false friend: actual hours are faktiska timmar.
Eventually means ultimately; eventuellt means possibly. Rephrase for the actual temporal context.
A knowledge base contains articles, not contact addresses.
The product entity groups submitted time entries; it is not a spreadsheet worksheet.
A timetable describes planned times; a timesheet records performed work.
Literal entry-as-admission calque; this is a recorded block of work time.
Keep background jobs distinct from project/workflow tasks; a job execution is a körning.
A running job executes; it does not physically run.
A software tenant is not a person renting premises.
Plural real-estate sense is wrong for software tenancy.
The Swedish metadata noun is spelled tagg. Swedish ett tag in prose is unrelated and remains valid.
English plural; Swedish metadata labels are taggar.
Use the Swedish plural of server.
This glossary uses the Swedish plural webhookar; preserve machine identifiers separately.
The Swedish plural of ett team is team. Microsoft Teams is an unchanged brand, exempt in integration/provider keys.
Standalone sum label is Totalt; the adjective total remains valid before a common-gender noun.
Use the Swedish billing subtotal noun.
Use consistent Swedish e-post terminology in generic labels; real addresses and official provider names stay unchanged.
Avoid mixed English/German spelling in Swedish email labels.
Mejl is valid Swedish, but this product standardizes on e-post in business UI; this is a consistency choice, not a claim of incorrect Swedish.
Avoid bureaucratic courtesy padding; a clear Swedish imperative provides professional, respectful instruction.
Do not mechanically add vänligen to every English please; concise imperatives are the product register.
Do not use capitalized honorific Ni for an individual user. Sentence-initial Ni is valid only when explicitly addressing a group; rephrase collective product copy to name the organization.
Archaic possessive is not contemporary Swedish business UI.
Avoid archaic standalone negation; established compounds such as icke-debiterbar remain valid.
Finland-Swedish regional phone word; sv-SE uses mobil or mobiltelefon.
Regional plural; use the Sweden-Swedish phone term.
Dated Swedish abbreviation for automatic data processing; contemporary managed-service copy uses IT.
A phone-type label needs the noun Arbete, not the verb arbeta; the verb is valid in sentences.
The CRM stage describes a verbal commitment; use a complete Swedish noun phrase.
CRM stage labels are participles agreeing with affärsmöjlighet, not finite past-tense verbs.

dialectRules.rule: Use professional, neutral Sweden-Swedish with direct imperatives and lowercase du, dig, din, ditt, dina for an individual user.
dialectRules.notes: The guide's formal business register means respectful and precise language, not honorific Ni, archaic Eder, slang, or bureaucratic padding. Use ni/er only for a real plural audience or an explicitly addressed organization. Usually omit English please; Spara ändringar and Ange en e-postadress are complete instructions.

dialectRules.rule: Use sentence case for headings, labels, buttons, and menu items; do not copy English title case.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: Skapa ärende, Alla kunder, Inställningar för fakturering. Common nouns, languages, weekdays, and month names are lowercase in running text. Capitalize the first word of a standalone label and preserve proper names and acronyms.

dialectRules.rule: Write Swedish noun compounds as one word and retain å, ä, and ö.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: kundportal, tjänstekatalog, avtalsrad, tidrapport, e-postadress. Join acronym/name compounds with a hyphen where needed: API-nyckel, SLA-avtal, Microsoft 365-integrering. Do not introduce English spaced noun stacks such as kund portal or service katalog.

dialectRules.rule: Inflect adjectives and participles for common gender, neuter, and plural; use gender-neutral role nouns.
dialectRules.notes: En tilldelad uppgift, ett tilldelat ärende, tilldelade ärenden; en användare/flera användare and en tekniker/flera tekniker. Inflected forms in context are valid realizations of glossary base forms. Do not mechanically reuse a common-gender status inside a neuter sentence.

dialectRules.rule: Preserve existing plural keys and use Swedish cardinal one and other forms for the corresponding variants.
dialectRules.notes: One: {{count}} ärende or {{count}} timme; other: {{count}} ärenden or {{count}} timmar, including zero. Keep placeholder names and counts exact; an explicit zero variant may say Inga ärenden. Do not add or rename keys during value translation.

dialectRules.rule: Use Swedish double quotation marks ”…” and nested single marks ’…’ in prose.
dialectRules.notes: Both outer quotation marks are U+201D; example: Välj ”Spara”. Use a colon before an introduced list and ellipsis … when the source indicates continuation. Preserve code delimiters, JSON escapes, markup, URLs, and functional ASCII quotation marks inside technical examples. Avoid exclamation marks in routine success messages.

dialectRules.rule: Format human-readable numbers with a decimal comma and a nonbreaking space for thousands: 1 234,56.
dialectRules.notes: Use a space before percent and unit symbols: 25 %, 2,5 h, 512 MB. Do not carry over English decimal points or thousands commas into displayed prose. Machine-readable decimals, version numbers, IP addresses, code, CSV requirements, and placeholder values are not localized by editing strings.

dialectRules.rule: Keep the transaction currency and use Swedish number formatting with a space before the currency indicator.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: 1 234,50 kr for SEK in an unambiguous domestic context or 1 234,50 SEK where the currency must be explicit. Preserve ISO codes such as EUR and USD; never convert a foreign currency to SEK or change amounts. Let the existing locale-aware formatter determine rendered currency placement.

dialectRules.rule: Use year-month-day for numeric dates (2026-09-23), day month year in prose (23 september 2026), and the 24-hour clock.
dialectRules.notes: The ISO-style numeric form avoids ambiguous US ordering. Swedish prose can use kl. 14.30; existing sv-SE UI formatters may render 14:30 and should remain authoritative. Do not use AM/PM, English ordinal suffixes, or change timezone/UTC offsets. Week starts Monday; week numbers follow ISO conventions when displayed. Preserve literal technical ISO timestamps and format tokens.

dialectRules.rule: Translate calendar names and keep them lowercase except at the start of a sentence or standalone label.
dialectRules.notes: Months: januari, februari, mars, april, maj, juni, juli, augusti, september, oktober, november, december. Weekdays: måndag, tisdag, onsdag, torsdag, fredag, lördag, söndag. Only April, September, November, and December are English-identical full month names when capitalized as standalone labels; August is not Swedish augusti.

dialectRules.rule: Preserve official product, provider, and organization names, including their capitalization; translate surrounding generic nouns and actions.
dialectRules.notes: Examples: AlgaPSA, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Stripe, QuickBooks Online, NinjaOne. Use an official Swedish product name when one is established for the actual product being referenced; do not invent literal brand translations. Integration names can retain Google Calendar. Teams is a brand exception, not the Swedish plural of team. A whole sentence is not exempt just because it contains a brand.

dialectRules.rule: Keep established acronyms such as SLA, API, URL, PSA, MSP, HTTP, JSON, CSV, PDF, and SSO unchanged.
dialectRules.notes: Use Swedish surrounding text and hyphenated compounds: API-nyckel, PDF-fil, SLA-avtal. Translate generic labels: kund-ID for a customer, klient-ID for an OAuth client, klientorganisations-ID for a tenant. Preserve an exact external English console label only when the instructions explicitly quote that label; never assume every uppercase word is an acronym.

dialectRules.rule: Distinguish debitering, fakturering, faktura, betalning, kreditering, tillgodohavande, and kreditfaktura.
dialectRules.notes: Debitering calculates charges; fakturering creates/issues invoices; betalning settles them. Kreditering is a credit transaction, tillgodohavande an available credit balance, kreditfaktura a credit document. Use offert for a sales quote and budget for a spending plan; taxa, enhetspris, and enhetskostnad stay distinct. Generic tax is skatt; VAT alone is moms. Do not infer tax rules from the Swedish locale.

dialectRules.rule: Keep tjänsteperiod for service coverage and faktureringsintervall for the window grouping charges into invoices.
dialectRules.notes: These can differ in recurring billing. Contract lines are avtalsrader; document line items are rader with a contextual prefix such as fakturarader. Timpott means contracted hours, not object storage.

dialectRules.rule: Use ärende for support tickets, uppgift for project tasks, bakgrundsjobb for background jobs, körning for executions, and arbetsflöde for automation workflows.
dialectRules.notes: AlgaPSA workflows are event-driven automations with utlösare and åtgärder. Tidpost is one work-time record; tidrapport groups records for approval; tidregistrering is the overall activity. Resursplanering assigns/schedules technicians. Do not collapse these concepts into one generic task or schedule.

dialectRules.rule: Use contemporary Sweden-Swedish vocabulary consistently, without importing regional phone terms or neighboring-language spellings.
dialectRules.notes: Use e-post, mobiltelefon, dator, fil, skärm, användare, and ladda ner. Mejl is valid Swedish but e-post is the product choice. Do not imitate Danish/Norwegian forms such as gem, indstillinger, innstillinger, or lagre; standard Swedish actions include Spara and Inställningar. Do not transliterate å/ä/ö in prose.

dialectRules.rule: Translate address/contact field labels while preserving actual contact data and international identifiers.
dialectRules.notes: Use Ort, Postnummer, Land, Telefonnummer. Swedish illustrative postal format is 123 45; international real addresses remain unchanged. Never replace a real phone country code with +46, translate a person's name, or modify an email address.

dialectRules.rule: Translate string values only and preserve every interpolation token, JSON key, markup element, and technical identifier exactly.
dialectRules.notes: Keep {{count}}, {{name}}, formatting suffixes inside placeholders, HTML tags/attributes, component tags, URLs, filenames, API fields, and literal code intact. Reorder complete placeholders where Swedish syntax requires it, but do not translate their names or drop one. Preserve intentional line breaks and escaping; no new markup or explanatory text not warranted by the source.

dialectRules.rule: Allow English-identical strings only when the complete string matches a justified exact item, established loanword, or narrowly defined technical pattern.
dialectRules.notes: The lists are based on the Portuguese/German reference allowlists with Swedish-inappropriate entries removed. Ticket, Assets, Board, Workflow, Email, Subtotal, Total, Name, and Optional need translation. Do not blanket-allow uppercase words, arbitrary English labels plus placeholders, free-form text following URLs, decimal-point display amounts, or English plural endings. Unit min and h are invariant; the Swedish day word is dag/dagar.

exact: phase_name, task_description, assigned_to, estimated_hours, due_date, priority, service, task_type, status, tags
identicalAllowlist.notes: Conservative Swedish subset of the Portuguese/German reference exceptions, with explicit ISO currency/country codes and invariant units added. Exact names and technical examples are preserved only as complete strings; Teams refers to the Microsoft brand. Month homographs are april, september, november, december, with initial capitals only in standalone labels. Case-insensitive entries are established Swedish forms, not permission to retain English plurals or untranslated compounds. Technical patterns are anchored and exclude arbitrary uppercase words, English UI labels, and prose appended to URLs. Visible percentages and units require Swedish spacing and decimal commas; code/identifiers remain literal. A translated sentence containing a brand is not automatically allowlisted.
